lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me. This is a safety risk. If your ex is nearby right now or you feel unsafe, call nine one one now. If you can move, go to a staffed public spot and stay where people can see you. Next, call two one one and ask for a domestic violence advocate in Oregon City for safe shelter and help with Court paperwork if he filed first. I can stay with you while you make the call.
originalTexts: Thank you for telling me. This is a safety risk. If your ex is nearby right now or you feel unsafe, call 911 now. If you can move, go to a staffed public spot and stay where people can see you. Next, call 211 and ask for a domestic violence advocate in Oregon City for safe shelter and help with court paperwork if he filed first. I can stay with you while you make the call.
